description.value:
While you're raging, unarmored by anything heavier than what you started with (no heavy armor, no shield), a hit with an unarmed strike or improvised weapon can become something more: you may give up your rage damage bonus on that hit to instead trigger a reckless strike, choosing one of the options below.

Some reckless strikes force a saving throw, using the following DC:

Reckless Strike save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier

You can use these options together a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus (per the berserker table), regaining all uses after a short or long rest.

Bracing Strike. You gain temporary hit points equal to your rage damage bonus — doubled if the target was already grappled by you.

Punishing Strike. The target must succeed on a Constitution save or be deafened until the start of its next turn; if it was grappled by you, it's incapacitated for that same duration instead.

Staggering Strike. The target chooses to make a Strength or Dexterity save; on a failure it's pushed back 5 feet, or knocked prone instead if it was grappled by you.
